before: Inserting a picture while a picture was selected failed late with a raw store reason, and refused picture inserts and replacements sent no diagnostic.
after: The insert is refused before any edit with a reason and the public code edit.picture-selected, and every refused picture insert or replacement sends an edit.rejected diagnostic.
reason: The refusal happens before any operation is built, and the diagnostic only observes the result. Shared state, document operations, and the collaboration format are unchanged.
